description.value: Coal Harbour Liquor Store is a licensed wine and spirits retailer (BC Liquor License 195427) in the Coal Harbour neighbourhood of downtown Vancouver. The shop operates both a walk-in retail location and a Shopify-based online delivery service, with a curated focus on wine. Touring cyclists passing through the area could stop to pick up beverages, though the business's public-facing identity centres strongly on home delivery.

address.value: 1218 W Pender St., Vancouver, BC V6E 4N1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the physical store address (1218 W Pender St., Vancouver, BC V6E 4N1) matching OSM, and supplies a phone number (+6046851212) absent from OSM tags. The website is an e-commerce/delivery platform for wine and spirits with no mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-relevant amenity; OSM's wheelchair=yes tag cannot be corroborated from website content alone. As a physical liquor store the record marginally fits the 'Food & Drink' category but meets none of the confirmed required WWC criteria.
